businessProblem: P6-1 makes both management-console login and access recovery public protocols. The current IAM registry incorrectly represents anonymous password and OTP login as authenticated workspace work, while the R5 operation and typed-error ledgers omit the new platform and operations recovery surface. This metadata-only control package makes the frozen public-protocol rule mechanically reviewable before the U01 contract and generated-surface work continues.
